notes.title: Update Version 1.5 - Interactivity!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello my friends!
Here a new cool update for you, here the add-ons ːwoodlefatherː

[b]- Soul customization! ːespritː (you will change colour based on the books you'll read, aquiring self knowledge)

- Interaction with other players! (you'll be able to interact with some object on the island, for example a ball!)

- Number of items collected saved! (you can quit the game and then the status will be saved)

	[/b]

Hope you'll like this new super update :)	[/h1]
